mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the axle into the blades felt worthwhile because it connected the spinning part to its support.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two flipping steps felt less engaging than joining the parts, though they made the assembly sequence clear.

surprise.text: Nothing particularly surprising happened; each new goal clearly identified the next step.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each had a clear purpose in assembling or orienting the pinwheel.

continue.text: I would try another chapter to see what else I could build, though I hope it offers a few more decisions beyond following explicit instructions.
